top_signals.title: Stocks, Treasuries Get Relief Ahead of CPI, US Diesel Passes $6/Gallon
top_signals.summary: US equity futures and Treasuries find some relief as investors await the latest inflation data for a signal on whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week. US diesel prices rose above $6 a gallon for the first time ever, raising the risk of further energy-driven inflation. The US marks 25 years since the September 11 terrorist attacks. Isabelle Mateos Y Lago of BNP Paribas joins "Bloomberg Brief" to look ahead to the CPI data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Tesla Shares Suffer Slow Summer After SpaceX IPO, Earnings Rout
top_signals.summary: For a decade and a half, Tesla Inc. offered the only public market bet on Elon Musk. But since SpaceX began trading in June, the electric vehicle giant has had to share its special sauce as it tests investor sentiment.
